text: We skim more than ever and remember less.
Listening might be the way back.
Most of what we read today, we do not really read at all.
We glance at a headline, drag a thumb down the page, and move on before the second paragraph has had a chance to speak.
The words pass in front of us, but very little of them stays.
Reading slowly is not about being slow.
It is about giving a sentence the time it was written to take.
